info.name: VTex Anti-fraud Provider Account Shopping Cart API

params.name: RnbBehavior
params.description:
This parameter defines which promotions apply to the simulation. Use `0` for simulations at cart stage, which means all promotions apply. In case of window simulation use `1`, which indicates promotions that apply nominal discounts over the total purchase value shouldn't be considered on the simulation.

Note that if this not sent, the parameter is `1`.

items.docs:
This endpoint is used to simulate a cart in VTEX Checkout.

It receives an SKU ID, the quantity of items in the cart and the seller ID.

It returns all information about the cart, such as the selling price of each item, pricing and promotion data, payment and logistics info.

This request is useful whenever you need to know the availability of fulfilling an order for a specific cart setting, since the API response will let you know the updated price, inventory and shipping data.

params.name: orderFormId
params.description: ID of the orderForm corresponding to the cart whose information you want to retrieve.

params.name: refreshOutdatedData
params.description: It is possible to use the [Update cart items request](https://developers.vtex.com/vtex-rest-api/reference/cart-update#itemsupdate) so as to allow outdated information in the `orderForm`, which may improve performance in some cases. To guarantee that all cart information is updated, send this request with this parameter as `true`. We recommend doing this in the final stages of the shopping experience, starting from the checkout page.

info.name: VTex Remove all items from shopping cart

params.name: orderFormId
params.description: ID of the orderForm corresponding to the cart whose items you want to remove.

items.docs:
This request removes all items from a given cart, leaving it empty.

You must send an empty JSON in the body of the request.

The [orderForm](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/guides/orderform-fields) is the data structure which represents a shopping cart and contains all information pertaining to it. Hence, the `orderFormId` is the identification code of a given cart.

>ℹ️ Request body must always be sent with empty value "{ }" in this endpoint.

info.name: VTex Remove all personal data from shopping cart

params.name: orderFormId
params.description: ID of the orderForm corresponding to the cart whose user's personal data you want to remove.

items.docs:
This call removes all user information, making a cart anonymous while leaving the items.

The [orderForm](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/guides/orderform-fields) is the data structure that represents a shopping cart and contains all information about it. Hence, the `orderFormId` is the identification code of a given cart.

This call works by creating a new orderForm, setting a new cookie, and returning a redirect 302 to the cart URL (`/checkout/#/orderform`).

params.name: allowedOutdatedData
params.description:
In order to optimize performance, this parameter allows some information to not be updated when there are changes in the minicart. For instance, if a shopper adds another unit of a given SKU to the cart, it may not be necessary to recalculate payment information, which could impact performance.

This array accepts strings and currently the only possible value is `”paymentData”`.

info.name: VTex Ignore profile data on checkout

params.name: orderFormId
params.description: ID of the orderForm corresponding to the cart whose items will have the price changed.

items.docs:
When a shopper provides an email address at Checkout, the platform tries to retrieve existing profile information for that email and add it to the shopping cart information. Use this request if you want to change this behavior for a given cart, meaning profile information will not be included in the order automatically.

The [orderForm](https://developers.vtex.com/docs/guides/orderform-fields) is the data structure which represents a shopping cart and contains all information pertaining to it.

info.name: VTex Add coupons to the cart

params.name: orderFormId
params.description: ID of the orderForm that will receive coupon information.

items.docs:
Use this request to add coupons to a given shopping cart.

To add multiple coupons to the same cart, you need to:

1. Request the activation of this feature through the [Support VTEX](https://help.vtex.com/support) if this is the first time you perform this action on your store.
2. Submit all coupon codes in the same requisition separated by commas. E.g.: {"text": "freeshipping, discount10, holiday30"}.

For more information on multiple coupons, access the [coupons tutorial](https://help.
